subject: Choices of C++ compiler for matlabstan on windows

messages.author: 7b2fb40653accdcf
messages.subject: Choices of C++ compiler for matlabstan on windows
parts: Sorry if there is an obvious answer that I missed, but is a separate C++ compiler required to run matlabstan on windows?

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Choices of C++ compiler for matlabstan on windows
parts:
Yes, a C++ compiler is required to use CmdStan. 

We suggest RTools because it's the one where we can reliably set up on multiple windows configurations, but if you're a config guru, you might be able to install and run with a different compiler. 

Install instructions for Rtools: https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/Install-Rtools-for-Windows

Daniel
